name: Float Hypervisors mint and redeem shares at the pool's instantaneous tick
summary: Float Protocol's two Visor-style Hypervisors on the FLOAT/WETH Uniswap V3 pool price deposits and total holdings with the pool's current tick. Their only guard is a DepositProxy ratio check against those same manipulable holdings. Swapping the pool, depositing through the whitelisted DepositProxy, swapping back and withdrawing returns more value than was deposited. 0x492d2552 did this against Hypervisor B on 2026-07-30. 0xaea29218 repeated it against both Hypervisors on 2026-09-01.

loss.notes: Attackers' gross realised extraction, a lower bound on the Hypervisor holders' loss. In source-1, 0x492d2552 received 5.502794615000686908 WETH net (unwrapped to ETH; 5.499404026050304823 ETH then went to builder 0x6c42a0b5, which does not reduce the loss) at ETH 1921.1729153052704. In source-2, 0xaea29218 received 10.706591043820923462 ETH net at ETH 2447.2727076168653. The Hypervisors' measured depletion is larger: source-1 took 7.975817164335609226 WETH from Hypervisor B while leaving 2,568.549500696945334661 more FLOAT, and source-2 took 5,003.835636638384594363 FLOAT and 1.637791718201924993 WETH from Hypervisor A and 37,021.255010587666626779 FLOAT and 1.556302565234474972 WETH from Hypervisor B. At the pre-exploit DefiLlama FLOAT quote (0.4937, then 0.6501) that is about 41.9k USD, but the attackers' disposal moved the FLOAT price, so realised proceeds are used. The PoC reports ~$28K for source-2 only.

ageReset.description: Owner appendList([DepositProxy 0x7cf8431e086e1bcdc9524fd305f7d5d8622cd75f]) made list(proxy) true. With the whitelist switched on two blocks later, that proxy is the only way into Hypervisor B. Later changes only restricted it: DepositProxy depositDelta 20 -> 11, and whitelist edits that left the proxy listed.

sources.note: Root cause, targets and anchor. Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid=1, v0.7.6) of Hypervisor 0x85cbed52 (A) and 0xc86b1e7f (B): deposit() takes price from TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(currentTick()) and pool0/pool1 from getTotalAmounts(), and mints deposit1 + deposit0*price scaled by totalSupply/(pool0*price + pool1). The only gate is list[to] while whitelisted. DepositProxy 0x38037294 (for A) and 0x7cf8431e (for B), verified, deposit to themselves when freeDeposit is false after properDepositRatio, which compares the deposit ratio with getTotalAmounts() within depositDelta; freeDeposit is false and depositDelta 11 at both exploits. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-2 (block 25874402, index 1): Morpho flash of 1000 WETH, UniV2 flash swap of FLOAT, pool 0xe8c2030686fc3b0161ee1def0e8d01dfe4fac0ac swaps (0x128acb08), then deposit(8dbdbe6d) twice on each DepositProxy and withdraw (b460af94) twice on each Hypervisor. The first deposit reads slot0 and getTotalAmounts inside the Hypervisor. Receipt of source-1 (block 25646362, index 0, EIP-7702 EOA 0x492d2552 calling itself): FLOAT bought through UniV2 0x481ddaf9, V3 0x7ee092fd and pool 0xe8c20306; 199999.99999999997 FLOAT deposited via DepositProxy B into Hypervisor B for 134.1726305403193 shares; FLOAT sold back into pool 0xe8c20306; the shares withdrawn for 167720.93556073649 FLOAT from the Hypervisor plus 29356.702823011503 FLOAT and 7.565746776980904 WETH, and 396.57978016131005 FLOAT and 0.43052938457394013 WETH, from the pool position burns. Age: eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-3).contractAddress = B (block 13615043, index 5, creator 0x3e738bef); code empty at 13615042; keccak256(runtime) = 0x5e7a0d5b...a84e at 13615043 and 25646361. Hypervisor A (first exercised in source-2): created at 13507015 (0xf856649f7ebaf9b33ab505d286394026a0fe1eab9969fc6a93ffe5ee49ba5a4b), keccak256 0xd5cf5cf1...5491 at 13507015 and 25874401. eth_call list(DepositProxy B) on B is 0 at 13615064 and 1 at 13615065 (source-4, 13615065:167), whitelisted true from 13615067 through 25646361. For A: list(DepositProxy A) is 0 at 13597276 and 1 at 13597277 (0x5d219f7094bcf1f8d46407419b966bde488dff6559cbb1ac0fd6b318c79f0f0e), whitelisted true from 13596462; both earlier than B's listing. Owner txlists of both Hypervisors and both proxies up to the exploits show only 2021-2022 administration: toggleWhitelist, appendList/removeListed with the proxies staying listed, setDepositDelta 20 -> 11, toggleDepositFree x4 (net false), setDepositMax and setMaxTotalSupply, and transferOwnership. None enables deposits after the listing. Earliest exercise: Etherscan getLogs of Deposit (0x4e2ca051) and Withdraw (0xebff2602) on both Hypervisors from 13507015 to the exploits give 19 and 52 deposits; the only earlier transaction with both a deposit and a withdraw is source-1.

Loss. Hypervisor B getTotalAmounts at 25646361 -> 25646362: FLOAT 35829951883163759943192 -> 38398501383860705277853, WETH 9686655655513362286 -> 1710838491177753060, totalSupply 25822459031228651839 unchanged. Source-2: A FLOAT 5194069778095623426887 -> 190234141457238832524, WETH 1638917053865289727 -> 1125335663364734, supply 2064504523257148120 unchanged; B FLOAT 38307977641733899769446 -> 1286722631146233142667, WETH 1734575539542574070 -> 178272974308099098, supply 25822437733451680325 unchanged. No other transaction in either block emits Hypervisor events. Attacker extraction: in source-1, WETH transfers to and from 0x492d2552 net +5502794615000686908, and FLOAT nets 0; the WETH is unwrapped (573.894779723493068959 out vs 568.391985108492382052 in), and 5.499404026050304823 ETH goes to builder 0x6c42a0b5 (debug_traceTransaction value transfers). In source-2, attack contract 0xb46655eb receives 10706591043820923462 wei from WETH and SELFDESTRUCTs it to EOA 0xaea29218. USD: 5.502794615000686908 x 1921.1729153052704 + 10.706591043820923462 x 2447.2727076168653.

limitations: Loss is the attackers' realised extraction, a lower bound on the Hypervisor holders' depletion, because FLOAT's price moved in the disposal.
